jdk.internal.util.xml.impl

类 Input

  • java.lang.Object
    • jdk.internal.util.xml.impl.Input

  • public class Input
extends Object
    A parsed entity input state. This class represents a parsed entity input state. The parser uses an instance of this class to manage input.
